scientific_integrity: The results are based on a full analytic argument and finite independent numerical corroboration; numerical checks do not prove universal claims.
scientific_limitations: The sharp maximizer classification holds for Euclidean ball prisms with one interval factor and dimension \(d\ge4\); equivalent historical results outside the inspected literature may exist. Brzezinski (2013) and Meyer (1999) were inspected only at abstract level.
title: A sharp orientation transition for maximal hyperplane sections of Euclidean ball prisms
